name: SVHS TAP-05052022
source:
SVHS TAP-05052022 is a DDLC mod that is somewhat of an adaptation of Alex Kister’s Mandela Catalog (And analog horror as a whole). This is somewhat of a “what if” scenario regarding if DDLC was intruded by concepts seen in analog horror.

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/svhs-tap-05052022/]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
SVHS TAP-05052022是一个DDLC模组，在某种程度上改编自Alex Kister的曼德拉目录（以及整个模拟恐怖）。这有点像“假设”场景，关于DDLC是否被模拟恐怖中的概念侵入。

[来自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/svhs-tap-05052022/]DokiMods[/url]]
